pages.text: How much a rocket can change its speed (Δv) depends on how fast its exhaust leaves (specific impulse, Isp) and on the ratio of full to empty mass. Because of the logarithm, adding fuel helps less and less: that is why rockets drop empty stages.
To lift off at all, thrust must beat weight: a thrust-to-weight ratio above 1, ideally about 1.3 to 1.5.
